about:
FP Performance Premium Exhaust Systems operates from Freehold, New Jersey. The company was founded by a group of passionate automotive enthusiasts who set out to redefine the performance exhaust segment by pushing the boundaries of performance, sound, and quality. No founding year is publicly disclosed, and the ownership structure has not been specified.

The company designs and manufactures performance exhaust systems, including cat-back kits, axle dump kits, and mufflers offered in Street Series and Race Series configurations. All systems are built from 304 stainless steel and engineered for direct-fit installation on specific platforms, such as the 1987–1993 Ford Mustang GT and LX. The product line currently comprises four core product families, though facility size, headcount, and annual production volumes are not disclosed.

FP Performance serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting performance enthusiasts and owners of classic Foxbody Mustangs. Its direct-fit systems are marketed to drivers seeking a distinctive, nostalgic sound combined with modern durability. The company references independent dyno testing to validate performance claims.

The founders started the business to challenge the status quo in exhaust sound and quality, aiming to deliver unmatched durability, superior craftsmanship, and an unmistakable sound that elevates the driving experience. The brand positions itself on precision engineering and a commitment to a nostalgic yet refined exhaust note.
